title: fix(console): a lookup target the presence read served is not read again by name
body:
Fixes #35306

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台列表页上，查找字段指向包外对象（showcase 上是 `sys_user`）时，`?names=` 存在性读取已经带回了对象定义，之后不再按名字（`meta/object/sys_user`）再读一次；应用导航 `requiresObject` 与仪表盘部件对象同理。
- 为什么改：卡片要求列表页对查找目标只读一次；实测 showcase 列表页同一对象先后读两次，相隔约 0.7 秒，后一次是列表页的尾部请求之一。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `MetadataProvider.readObjectScope` 一处分支，只复用存在性读取「已返回定义」的答案；被省略（不存在或被拒）的名字照旧按名字读，所以「不存在」与「被拒（OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED）」的区分不变；草稿预览不复用。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`（`readObjectScope` 里 `presentDefinition` 分支与随后的 `bump()`），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/MetadataProvider.scopeRefusal-13052.test.tsx`（新增的拒绝边界钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/MetadataProvider.scopeRefusal-13052.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Traced first, on a real app** (showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh --ui` on a private port, production console build, signed in through the login page, headless Chromium 1440x900, one warm-up load, then a fresh page per load; every `/api/` Resource Timing entry to network idle plus 3 s; request initiators from the DevTools protocol).

1. **Both reads, in that order (A1 holds).** On the list page `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`, every run sent `meta/object?names=sys_user` and then `meta/object/sys_user`, 0.64 to 0.76 s later. Both initiator stacks run from a React render through `appObjectScope`; the second ends in the adapter's `getObjectSchema` (`fetchScopeName`, `readItem`).
2. **The presence answer carries everything the by-name path hands its callers (A2 holds).** Read live from the same server and session: the `sys_user` item in the `?names=` answer is deep-equal to `item` in the by-name answer. The by-name envelope adds `sortability` and `cascadeDeleteObjects`; the adapter puts both on its own copy under symbol keys, and the provider's `cloneServedObject` (a `structuredClone`) drops them, so no scope reader ever saw them. Switched-off actions ride both answers (`disabledActions`, keyed by object on the list door).
3. **The fix.** `readObjectScope`: before asking a name by name for a scope, take the definition the batched names scope (the presence read) already SERVED for it. Only a served answer is taken. A name the presence read left out, has not answered yet, or failed is asked by name exactly as before, so the by-name door stays the one authority on absent versus refused. The draft preview never takes it. A reader that asked the name for its side effect (a route's lookup targets) learns of it on the render the provider's `bump()` causes, as it would on a by-name answer landing.
4. **The same rule also answers** an app entry's `requiresObject` and a dashboard widget's object once their presence read has served them. Those were the same double read: on an app whose package holds no objects of its own, three by-name reads go away (the updated pins below show it).
5. **The ~0.7 s gap (A4).** The presence answer lands inside a long main-thread task (390 to 468 ms, the list page's render and chunk work), and in both instrumented runs the by-name request starts at the end of a later render task (start 2022 ms with a task ending 2022; start 1954 with a task ending 1955). The by-name read waited for the render that consumed the presence answer. With the read gone, that wait is gone too.

<details><summary>Readings: before (origin/main 81c09477) and after (this branch, a9490789 product code plus the bump fix)</summary>

Requests counted from navigation, chain depth = 1 + the deepest request that ENDED before this one STARTED.

| showcase list page | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/api/` requests per load | 26, 26, 26, 26, 26 | 25, 25, 25 |
| reads of `sys_user`'s definition | 2 (`?names=`, then by name) every run | 1 (`?names=`) every run |
| chain depth | 11, 11, 10, 12, 10 | 11, 12, 9 |
| the card's grouping (requests that run together) | 6 | 6 |

Before, run 2:

```
L5   1214->1232   meta/object?names=sys_user
L9   1789->1858   data/showcase_task, data/sys_user/ID, data/sys_inbox_message, approvals/requests
L10  1919->1942   meta/object/sys_user
L11  2083->2108   data/sys_notification_receipt
```

After, run 1:

```
L6    927->946    meta/object?names=sys_user
L10  1334->1421   data/showcase_task, data/sys_user/ID, data/sys_inbox_message, approvals/requests
L11  1598->1623   data/sys_notification_receipt
```

Long tasks (start, duration in ms) beside the before runs: run 1 `[1235,468] [1781,71] [1865,51] [1930,92]` with the presence answer at 1259 and the by-name start at 2022; run 2 `[1286,390] [1749,65] [1876,79]` with the presence answer at 1316 and the by-name start at 1954.
</details>

## Tests

- `MetadataProvider.scopeRefusal-13052.test.tsx`, new top-level describe on its real-`ObjectStackAdapter` harness: a name the presence read served joins the route scope with that definition and is asked by name zero times; a name it left out is asked by name and its refusal is still named `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` (flat and wrapped envelope); CONTROL: left out and answered 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` is the plain absence.
- The pins that encoded the old second read now pin one read: `appObjectScope-12811`, `AppContent.objectScope-12811` (the held-read case now holds the presence read), `AppContent.emptyPackageScope-13046`, `AppContent.packagelessReads-29416`, `AppContent.packagelessRecordRelated-29552`, `AppContent.packagelessRoot-29552` (a `note-entry` probe: the bundle answers it through the presence read, no request), `AppContent.pageRouteObjects-12980`, `AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784`, `packagelessChromeScope-12980`. Where a pin read the scope or the sidebar gate, it still asserts the object arrives there; the by-name call is what is gone.
- The no-404 pins of the presence read (an unregistered lookup target or `requiresObject` is never asked by name) pass unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `if (present) {` to `if (present && false) {`: 16 failed / 21 passed across `scopeRefusal-13052`, `appObjectScope-12811`, `AppContent.objectScope-12811`, the new served-name pin among them.
- `if (answeredFromPresence) bump();` deleted: 2 failed / 16 passed in `appObjectScope-12811` (`expected 'sys_invitation' to be 'sys_invitation,sys_user'`): without the bump a packageless list route never shows the target that joined its scope.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **HotCRM: NOT MEASURED.** HotCRM is not in this container; a shallow clone worked, but installing its dependencies (`pnpm install` in the clone) was refused by the session's permission classifier, so it could not be booted. The change is app-neutral (it keys on the presence read, not on any object name); the showcase readings above are the measured app.
- **The layer count does not drop on the showcase.** The by-name read shared the trailing group with `data/sys_notification_receipt`, which waits on `data/sys_inbox_message`, so the card's grouping stays at 6 and the chain depth stays in its noise band (9 to 12). What goes away is one request per load and the 0.6 to 0.8 s the page kept a request open after its data had landed.
- The absent/refused distinction of the batched names scope is unchanged and now pinned at the boundary this PR touches (Tests, first item). The batched scope's own doc comment and the lookup-target comment in `appObjectScope.ts` now say which part of its answer a route takes.
- The by-name read used to warm the adapter's own `getObjectSchema` cache for the target as a side effect. Nothing on the list page read that cache (the after trace has no by-name read of `sys_user` at all); a later reader that needs the schema reads it then.
